cupola-nadir-revisit.base: You look down. The flashes are still coming. Fewer now, perhaps. Or only harder to pick out from the smoke. You force yourself to look away.

examine-yevgenia.base: Yevgenia Kozlova. The station's engineer. Suspended in the middle of the corridor by zero-g.

examine-petrov.base: Commander Petrov. Thirty years of service. One hand still on the hatch wheel.
